pr_title: Don't create DSL sensor for devices that don't support DSL
pr_body:

## Proposed change
<!--
  Describe the big picture of your changes here to communicate to the
  maintainers why we should accept this pull request. If it fixes a bug
  or resolves a feature request, be sure to link to that issue in the

Fixes an issue, where DSL sensors where added also for devices, that don't support DSL connection (that are plain AP and not routers). Tested with fritzbox 6490, 4040 and 7490

Should be added to the [2021.09.0](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/milestone/429) release/milestone.
